# National Institute of Standards and Technology
> NIST promotes U.S. innovation and industrial competitiveness through measurement science, standards, and technology.

NIST is a U.S. federal agency that develops measurement methods, reference data, standards, and applied research across science, engineering, manufacturing, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies. Its website includes topic hubs, publications, laboratory programs, standards guidance, and practical resources for industry, government, and researchers.

## Core Topics
- [All Topics](https://www.nist.gov/topics): Directory of NIST research, standards, and technology topic areas.
- [Publications](https://www.nist.gov/publications): Search and browse NIST reports, journal articles, books, and conference papers.
- [Advanced Communications](https://www.nist.gov/advanced-communications): Research and standards work for wireless, spectrum sharing, and NextG communications.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.nist.gov/artificial-intelligence): AI measurement science, governance, standards, and trustworthy AI resources.
- [Cybersecurity and Privacy](https://www.nist.gov/cybersecurity-and-privacy): Cybersecurity frameworks, privacy guidance, and security engineering resources.
- [Information Technology](https://www.nist.gov/information-technology): Computing, software, data, and information systems research and standards.
- [Metrology](https://www.nist.gov/metrology): Measurement science foundations, traceability, calibration, and standards infrastructure.

## Physical Science and Engineering
- [Chemistry](https://www.nist.gov/chemistry): Chemical measurement science, reference data, analytical methods, and standards.
- [Electronics](https://www.nist.gov/electronics): Semiconductor, microelectronics, quantum, and electronic measurement research.
- [Materials](https://www.nist.gov/materials): Materials characterization, performance measurement, and standards for advanced materials.
- [Mathematics and Statistics](https://www.nist.gov/mathematics-statistics): Applied mathematics, statistical methods, uncertainty, and computational tools.
- [Energy](https://www.nist.gov/energy): Measurement science and standards supporting energy systems and efficiency.
- [Environment](https://www.nist.gov/environment): Environmental measurement science for climate, air, water, and related systems.

## Life Sciences and Health
- [Bioscience](https://www.nist.gov/bioscience): Measurement tools and standards for biotechnology, biomolecular systems, and biomanufacturing.
- [Health](https://www.nist.gov/health): Medical device, diagnostics, imaging, and health measurement science resources.
- [Forensic Science](https://www.nist.gov/forensic-science): Standards, methods, and scientific foundations for forensic practice.
- [Fire](https://www.nist.gov/fire): Fire research, safety engineering, wildfire science, and fire investigation support.

## Built Environment and Manufacturing
- [Buildings and Construction](https://www.nist.gov/buildings-construction): Building safety, codes, resilience, and construction measurement science.
- [Infrastructure](https://www.nist.gov/infrastructure): Research and standards for resilient infrastructure and critical systems.
- [Manufacturing](https://www.nist.gov/manufacturing): Advanced manufacturing measurement science, interoperability, and production technologies.
- [Metrology](https://www.nist.gov/metrology): Core measurement capabilities supporting industry, laboratories, and standards bodies.

## Cybersecurity, Privacy, and Digital Trust
- [Cybersecurity and Privacy](https://www.nist.gov/cybersecurity-and-privacy): Main hub for cybersecurity guidance, frameworks, and privacy engineering.
- [Cybersecurity Framework](https://www.nist.gov/cyberframework): NIST Cybersecurity Framework resources for managing cybersecurity risk.
- [Privacy Framework](https://www.nist.gov/privacy-framework): Privacy risk management guidance aligned with enterprise governance practices.
- [National Vulnerability Database](https://nvd.nist.gov): Vulnerability data, CVE mappings, and security reference information.
- [Computer Security Resource Center](https://csrc.nist.gov): Publications, standards, tools, and projects for information security and privacy.
- [National Checklist Program](https://ncp.nist.gov): Security configuration checklists for operating systems and applications.

## Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technology
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.nist.gov/artificial-intelligence): Central hub for NIST AI programs, publications, and standards activities.
- [AI Risk Management Framework](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework): Guidance for managing risks in design, development, and use of AI.
- [Trustworthy and Responsible AI](https://www.nist.gov/artificial-intelligence/trustworthy-and-responsible-ai): NIST work on reliable, safe, explainable, and accountable AI.
- [Advanced Communications](https://www.nist.gov/advanced-communications): Wireless innovation, spectrum research, and communications testbeds.
- [Electronics](https://www.nist.gov/electronics): Quantum, semiconductor, and device measurement research relevant to emerging technologies.

## Data, Reference Materials, and Measurement Services
- [Standard Reference Materials](https://www.nist.gov/srm): Certified reference materials for calibration, validation, and quality assurance.
- [Standard Reference Data](https://www.nist.gov/srd): Critically evaluated scientific and technical data products from NIST.
- [Calibration Services](https://www.nist.gov/calibrations): Calibration services supporting traceability to national measurement standards.
- [Weights and Measures](https://www.nist.gov/pml/owm): Legal metrology, training, handbooks, and measurement uniformity resources.
- [NIST Physical Measurement Laboratory](https://www.nist.gov/pml): Measurement services, standards, and research in the physical sciences.
- [NIST Research Library](https://www.nist.gov/library): Library services, collections, and research support resources.

## Publications and Research Outputs
- [Publications](https://www.nist.gov/publications): Official repository for NIST technical publications and research outputs.
- [Journal of Research of NIST](https://www.nist.gov/journal-research-nist): Peer-reviewed journal covering NIST research and measurement science.
- [News and Updates](https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news): News releases and announcements about NIST programs and results.
- [Events](https://www.nist.gov/news-events/events): Conferences, workshops, webinars, and public meetings hosted by NIST.
- [Videos](https://www.nist.gov/video): Video content explaining NIST research, standards, and public resources.

## Laboratories and Programs
- [Material Measurement Laboratory](https://www.nist.gov/mml): Research and services for materials, chemistry, bioscience, and health measurements.
- [Physical Measurement Laboratory](https://www.nist.gov/pml): Fundamental measurement science, standards, and calibration capabilities.
- [Information Technology Laboratory](https://www.nist.gov/itl): Cybersecurity, AI, software, networking, and information technology research.
- [Engineering Laboratory](https://www.nist.gov/el): Measurement science for manufacturing, infrastructure, and the built environment.
- [Communications Technology Laboratory](https://www.nist.gov/ctl): Wireless, public safety communications, spectrum, and network measurement research.
- [Center for Neutron Research](https://www.nist.gov/ncnr): Neutron scattering facilities and user resources for materials research.
- [Center for Nanoscale Science and Technology](https://www.nist.gov/cnst): Nanotechnology research facilities, tools, and collaborative programs.

## About and Access
- [About NIST](https://www.nist.gov/about-nist): Agency mission, organization, leadership, and institutional overview.
- [Contact Us](https://www.nist.gov/contact-us): Contact information and ways to reach NIST offices and programs.
- [Locations](https://www.nist.gov/about-nist/our-organization/locations): Information about NIST campuses and major facilities.
- [Careers at NIST](https://www.nist.gov/careers): Employment, fellowships, internships, and workforce opportunities.
- [NIST Organization](https://www.nist.gov/about-nist/our-organization): Organizational structure, laboratories, and program offices.
- [Subscribe to Email Updates](https://www.nist.gov/subscribe): Email subscriptions for NIST news, events, and topic updates.
